description:
[[File:Boundingbox.jpg|right|200px]] Returns a bounding box of given object in model coordinate space, adjusted according to destruction/animation of an object. This command is rather generous on the size estimation, for more precise coordinates use [[boundingBoxReal]].
{{Feature|informative|In {{GVI|arma3|1.92}} The output of both syntaxes got extended to include bounding sphere diameter. See also [[sizeOf]].}}
name: boundingBox

ret.desc:
an array with the extreme points of the model, as well as bounding box sphere diameter.
Format [[xmin, ymin, zmin], [xmax, ymax, zmax], boundingSphereDiameter].

NumberEnum.desc: ClipVisual (could significantly reduce the size of bounding boxes on buildings)
ClipGeneral (Default, the same type that is used in main syntax)

ret.desc:
an array with the extreme points of the model bounding box, as well as bounding box sphere diameter.
Format [[xmin, ymin, zmin], [xmax, ymax, zmax], boundingSphereDiameter].
